extraction: unified-memory provides MCP server for durable context handoffs between agents — Engine writes Phase 6 outputs to vault, Verdict reads + writes fix specs, Miss reads specs + writes patches. Scopes: project, session, task. Each handoff carries provenance (agent, timestamp, decision_id). Maps to our 18-lang OCR goal by enabling Engine→Verdict→Miss coordination without context loss on weak cells (Santali 53.91, Kashmiri 54.82).
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether we use unified-memory as mandatory handoff backbone vs ad-hoc file passing
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
